description: This Java source file implements an endurance testing utility that runs a specified number of cycles to test engine types via hardware commands, logging progress and timings.

classes.name: EnduranceTest
classes.description: Main class for performing high-cycle endurance testing on hardware engines using command sequences.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes the endurance test with configurable cycle count; manages hardware connection, command execution, logging, and timing.

methods.name: parseCount
methods.description: Parses the cycle count from command line arguments; defaults to 2000 if not provided.
